div.span:
Proposed changes (1-20 operations)
e.g. ec2.stop, ec2.change_type, sg.revoke_ingress,
s3.make_private, rds.enable_encryption, iam.detach_policy

Record baseline fingerprint
(SHA-256 of resources, metrics, costs, clock)

analysis.analyze(baseline)
findings, score, run-rate, compliance, exposure

Compare: cost delta, findings resolved / introduced,
score delta, exposure, downtime + dependents,
compliance %, config diff

Store what-if run (status SIMULATED)
audit WHATIF_EXECUTED

run_operations(real environment)
status APPLIED, audit WHATIF_APPLIED
